prompt: A wide, high view over central London on a rain-soaked night, as if from an upper-floor window of an office block across the river: the Houses of Parliament small in the middle distance beside the black curve of the Thames, surrounded by miles of ordinary lit city, office windows, rooftops, cranes with red warning lights, wet streets glinting.
